payload_readiness_component.policy: Generation coverage excludes not_available_in_payload requirements. Payload readiness is reported separately for audit.

coverage_component.policy: Generation coverage excludes not_available_in_payload requirements. Payload readiness is reported separately for audit.

new_section_generation_score.scoring_policy: Coverage uses deterministic supported-scope evidence mapping. LLM judges are a separate quality signal. Payload readiness is reported separately and missing synthetic payload items do not lower the generation score.

change_summary: Re-structured the section to follow IFRS S1 general requirements more clearly (basis of preparation, reporting period/currency, comparatives, connected information, methodologies and judgements).
Tightened and de-duplicated narrative while retaining decision-useful linkages between governance, risk management, scenario analysis and metrics using only supported evidence.
Improved table presentation by consolidating multi-year financial measures into a single, clean comparative table with consistent units.
Strengthened evidence clarity by anchoring connected-information examples to specific risk register and scenario analysis statements and by keeping quantitative disclosures to evidenced values.

policy: Approved sections below target are refined once using supported evidence, then re-checked through claims, deterministic gates, judges and approval. Refined text is kept only when it improves safely.
